resolution.note: Dropped 2026-11-21 by operator order: CI Check is the only gate; tasks that add, tighten or patch a refusal are not done (see .krn/runs/prune/gates.md)

title: A second ship on a live-shipping pull request is refused
body:
Files: src/cli/lane-finish.ts, src/cli/pr.ts, src/cli/help.ts
Outcome: a second `krn pr ship` on a pull request whose ship is already live refuses (or attaches to the live one) instead of starting a duplicate CI run; a stale failed `Check` from a cancelled run on the same HEAD no longer blocks auto-merge.
Evidence: 2026-11-19 PR #1496 on 79646fd: two ships ran at once; runs 44536426232 and 44536433429 cancelled each other, leaving a `Check` FAILURE beside a `Check` SUCCESS on the same SHA and the PR BLOCKED with auto-merge off until the cancelled run was rerun by hand.
Do: detect a live ship for the same branch (pid file under .krn/) and refuse with a clear exit; on exit 74 distinguish all-jobs-cancelled from a red test and say "rerun, do not re-ship".
Proof: a test that a second ship on a branch with a live ship exits non-zero without pushing or starting a run.
